cards.title: Visit-Note Explainer
cards.one_line: Turn a sample visit note, lab chart, or discharge summary into a plain-language patient guide, with a follow-up timeline grounded in the sample document. Use only sample or fictional data, never real patient information.

cards.title: Hospital Bill Decoder
cards.one_line: Explain itemized hospital-bill lines and codes in plain language, flag items to double-check, and help draft questions for the billing office. Use only sample or fictional bills, never a real patient’s bill.

cards.title: Cost-Before-Care Estimator
cards.one_line: For one fictional procedure and insurance plan, show how a cost estimate changes under different assumptions, and list what the patient still must verify. Use only fictional data, never a real patient’s coverage.

cards.title: Specialist-Visit Prep
cards.one_line: Help patients or caregivers gather symptoms, medication lists, records, tests, and a focused question list before a specialist visit. Use only sample or fictional records, never real patient charts.

cards.title: Home PT Plan Companion
cards.one_line: Turn one sample physical-therapy handout into illustrated exercise cards and a schedule, without changing the prescribed instructions. Use only a sample or fictional handout, never a real patient’s plan.

cards.title: Billable-Time Catcher
cards.one_line: Professionals who bill by the hour often forget to log time. Build an agent that picks up time spent per client or project across email, chat apps, and phone calls, then drafts a daily summary ready to enter into a time-tracking system.
